biggest_catch: Only talk minutes pay - sitting online for an hour with no calls can pay as little as $0 (15 min guaranteed only inside Priority Hours).
catches: Paid ONLY for talk minutes - time spent waiting for calls is unpaid.
Priority Hours guarantee pay for just 15 minutes per booked hour if no calls come in.
Rates are fixed with no negotiation: $10.20/hr standard, $12.00/hr Kids.
Payout option availability varies by country.

payout_quote: Official Help Center: 'We pay $0.17 USD per minute ($10.20/hour) for Cambly and $0.20 USD per minute ($12.00) for Cambly Kids, processing your earnings on Tuesdays via your choice of PayPal or Stripe.' Tutors can choose payouts every 1, 2, or 4 weeks.
steps: Apply on cambly.com (intro video; approval can take days to weeks).
Open your schedule and/or Priority Hours.
Chat with students; every talk minute is tracked at $0.17/min ($0.20/min Kids).
Earnings process on Tuesdays to PayPal/Stripe at your chosen cadence.
timing: Earnings processed on Tuesdays via PayPal or Stripe; tutors choose 1-week, 2-week, or 4-week payout schedules.

repeatable.cadence: repeatable per talk minute; no calls, no pay

maximize: Book Priority Hours: they guarantee 15 minutes of pay per booked hour even if no student calls - free floor money. Apply for Cambly Kids ($12/hr vs $10.20). Convert one-off chats into reserved regulars so your online time is paid talk time, because waiting around earns nothing.
payout_value_note: $0.17/min Cambly ($10.20/hr) and $0.20/min Cambly Kids ($12/hr) official; per talk hour

who_pays: Cambly pays you directly from the platform at fixed per-minute rates - no student-side billing on your end.
who_qualifies: Native English speaker. No degree, certificate, or experience required. Needs a computer or phone with a camera; application includes an intro video and approval can take days to weeks.
what_gets_accepted: Only completed talk minutes count - every minute you're talking with a student is tracked at $0.17/min ($0.20/min Kids). Time waiting for calls is unpaid.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No upfront fee. Waiting for calls is unpaid (Priority Hours only guarantee 15 minutes of pay per booked hour if no calls come in). Application and onboarding time is unpaid, and payout option availability varies by country.
when_cash_arrives: Earnings are processed on Tuesdays via PayPal or Stripe; tutors choose payouts every 1, 2, or 4 weeks.
